name: Declared integrations are reachable and used
purpose: Every enduring integration a system declares is reachable by the AI, and one that is declared but never used is reported.
record: Eight written cases (evaluation/hands/build_cases.py): a declaration and the run records of a period with the expected list: integrations that are used, declared but idle, cut off (no tool named or disabled), two systems in one declaration, a system that declares nothing and a run that names an integration nobody declared. One number: the share of cases whose list equals the expected list. A real system's own declaration and runs are not in this set.
disadvantages: The declarations and run records are written, not a real system's.
cascading_conditionals: free [sample=full | real=no | gate=competitive | when=the arm and its rival were recorded on the same cases]
command: esoi run hands --impl declared_and_used; esoi run hands --impl declaration_only
